ai_settings_whole.name: ai_settings_whole
ai_settings_whole.value: ("ai_settings"."provider" IS NULL) = ("ai_settings"."quick_model" IS NULL) AND ("ai_settings"."provider" IS NULL) = ("ai_settings"."writer_model" IS NULL)

chat_messages_author.name: chat_messages_author
chat_messages_author.value: ("chat_messages"."author" = 'Member' AND "chat_messages"."member_name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("chat_messages"."author" = 'AI' AND "chat_messages"."member_id" IS NULL AND "chat_messages"."member_name" IS NULL)

deal_finder_price_reads_prices.name: deal_finder_price_reads_prices
deal_finder_price_reads_prices.value: coalesce("deal_finder_price_reads"."regular_price", "deal_finder_price_reads"."deal_price", "deal_finder_price_reads"."online_price") IS NOT NULL AND coalesce("deal_finder_price_reads"."regular_price", 1) BETWEEN 1 AND 999999 AND coalesce("deal_finder_price_reads"."deal_price", 1) BETWEEN 1 AND 999999 AND coalesce("deal_finder_price_reads"."online_price", 1) BETWEEN 1 AND 999999

merchant_lookups_found.name: merchant_lookups_found
merchant_lookups_found.value: ("merchant_lookups"."outcome" = 'found') = ("merchant_lookups"."category" IS NOT NULL AND "merchant_lookups"."confidence" IS NOT NULL AND "merchant_lookups"."description" IS NOT NULL)
